## Blockers

1. **Unchecked error.** `src/handler.mts:55` ignores the return value of `writeFile`. Add error handling.

instructions: Commit and push any code changes.
Journal substantial decisions or rejections, citing item URLs or review IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to one sentence on what changed and run, even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_human_1 --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --dismiss-review-ids PRR_bot_cr_2 --require-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"`
`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. Rerun the same command now.
